reason: Vitest drives PreviewRelayExtension with a page debugger and stock-shaped messages; keep the tab/session scope, command refusals, detach and remote-loopback cases as parity tests.

host.ts agentStart binds PreviewRelayExtension to one page's debugger; remote/preview-relay-tunnels.ts also uses relayExtensionUrl. Move the stock message protocol, allowed commands and child-session tracking to Rust with the shell's wc.cdp.send target. The bridge starting stock's relay is not this file.

Vitest exercises registerPreviewHost's window/session disposal, visual isolation, capture deadlines and paired-host relay. Keep these host contract tests alongside the real Preview e2e tests; the test doubles are not a native implementation.

ipc.ts registerIpcHandlers calls registerPreviewHost; preview:history (crates/core/src/browsing.rs), preview:visuals (crates/core/src/visuals/store.rs) and preview:device (crates/core/src/emulator.rs) now route directly tauri-shell -> ompdesk-core via H(c). Move page/window ownership, sessions, navigation gates and trusted gestures to tauri-shell's Preview owner. createPage selects a desktop view or an offscreen PageStream. PreviewStreamView calls preview.stream.poll/input via shared/omp-api.ts; PREVIEW_STREAM_POLL passes the acknowledgement to PageStream.poll, and PREVIEW_STREAM_INPUT routes InputMapper/InputSequence to the active viewer page. Port polling/pacing, dialog replies and ordered input with that owner; keep device permissions at the core web edge and the getSelection expression in the browser. Do not replace native paint/input with a second browser target.
Vitest pins clamping to the owner window, hidden/invalid sizes and centered frame scaling. Reuse the same cases at the Rust shell bounds boundary.

host.ts place uses fitPreviewFrame and applyPreviewLayout on the native child; placeStreamed reuses the fit with device DPR and host scale to size its offscreen window. Move both host-side calculations to the Rust Preview surface owner; leave panel measurement and CSS layout in the renderer.

PRELUDE observes trusted DOM events and draws picks, regions and comment pins in the loaded document. host.ts runOnPage evaluates pageCall in isolated PAGE_WORLD. Keep the injected JavaScript, not a native DOM copy; a Rust host can package the source and pass JSON arguments.
Vitest holds checkVisualPage to its total deadline, rejects late captures/verdicts and checks the tab's judge RPC and image sizes. Keep the public-result cases when the coordinator moves.

ipc.ts createTabCheck supplies tab RPC and VisualPages capture/flag to checkVisualPage. Move deadline, enabled/available and verdict coordination to core with the tab; acquire/resize the picture on the Rust Preview shell. judge_available and judge_preview_check still call that tab's stock bridge and use its quota.

host.ts agentStart dials localRelaySocket only for a local tab; a paired tab uses RemoteDevices.previewRelay. Move the local socket lifetime/frames to core with the relay transport (remote/preview-relay-tunnels.ts already talks to core remotebytes/relay.rs); keep the page debugger on the viewing machine.
Vitest pins visual URL identity, same-visual version changes and empty-document exceptions; keep the cases at the navigation policy boundary.

VisualStore.parse uses parseVisualUrl for record/version lookup; host.ts gates page-initiated navigation with visualMayNavigate. Move the shared visual identity parser and the synchronous navigation decision to Rust with the shell host. Versions of the same visual have different origins but may navigate to one another.

Vitest calls VisualStore.open/resolve/serve and runVisualizeTool with a temporary project, pre-native history.json and real core. Covers restart, user labels, exact binary and HTML input, version pruning, MIME and 404 responses.

ipc.ts registers gui_visualize; host.ts binds VisualStore.serve to the visual session. The core owns catalog summaries and version menus (visual.history/open in visuals/store/display.rs), writes and prunes history, and resolves visual.file by ID/version/URL path. Main caches display data for synchronous host.ts publish/loadVisual and retains tab membership, choice/reveal and response headers until the Rust Preview host owns them. The tool is not injected page code.
